meta.title: BC Practical Exam Scenarios
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice scenarios modeled on EMALB exam format

scenarios.titleEn: Fall From Ladder - Spinal Injury With Wrist Fracture
scenarios.titleZh: 梯子坠落——脊柱损伤合并腕部骨折
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1410 hrs. Code 3 to a single-storey residence in Burnaby. 34-year-old male fell from a ladder while cleaning gutters. Caller (his wife) reports he is conscious, lying on the back patio, complaining of neck pain. Fire is not attending. Closest hospital is 15 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:10，Code 3 前往本拿比一处平房住宅。34 岁男性清理排水槽时从梯子上坠落。报警人（其妻）称患者清醒，躺在后院露台上，主诉颈部疼痛。消防不到场。最近医院车程 15 分钟。

phases.infoEn: You and your partner are a BLS crew. Travel time to scene is 8 minutes. No update from dispatch en route.
phases.infoZh: 你与搭档为 BLS 双人组。到场车程 8 分钟。途中调度无更新信息。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge dispatch and plan equipment: spinal device, hard collars, splint kit, oxygen, analgesia kit
expected.actionZh: 确认派遣信息并计划装备：脊柱固定装置、硬质颈托、夹板包、氧气、镇痛用具

expected.actionEn: Anticipate hazards (ladder, wet surfaces) and PPE needs before arrival
expected.actionZh: 到场前预判危险源（梯子、湿滑地面）及个人防护需求

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Access is through a side gate to the backyard patio. An aluminum extension ladder lies on its side, clear of the patient. The patient is supine on the concrete patio where he landed and has NOT been moved. His wife kneels beside him. Overcast, 14 degrees C, dry. One patient. The gutter line is approximately 4 metres above the ground.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：经侧门进入后院露台。一架铝制伸缩梯侧倒在地，未压住患者。患者仰卧在坠落原地的混凝土露台上，未被移动过。妻子跪在旁边。阴天，14 摄氏度，地面干燥。单一患者。排水槽高度约离地 4 米。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards, environment, MOI (approx. 4 m fall onto concrete) and number of patients (1) before touching the patient
expected.actionZh: 接触患者前口述危险源、环境、受伤机制（约 4 米坠落至混凝土）及患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First-look visual assessment: patient supine, eyes open, holding very still, obvious right wrist deformity
expected.actionZh: 第一眼视诊：患者仰卧、睁眼、刻意保持不动，右腕明显畸形

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, oriented, speaks full sentences, keeps head still, complains of neck pain and right wrist pain. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway clear and self-maintained; respirations 18, regular, good volume; radial pulse 92, strong and regular. Skin (give during RBS): pink, warm, dry. RBS findings: midline cervical tenderness at C5-C6; right wrist dorsally deformed and swollen, distal circulation, sensation and function INTACT; no bleeding; no other injuries. SpO2 97% on room air.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常、能整句说话、自觉保持头部不动，主诉颈痛和右腕痛。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅、可自行维持；呼吸 18 次/分、规则、潮气量好；桡动脉搏动 92 次/分、有力规则。皮肤（RBS 时给出）：红润、温暖、干燥。RBS 发现：C5-C6 中线压痛；右腕背侧畸形肿胀，远端循环、感觉、活动均完好；无出血；无其他损伤。SpO2 室内空气 97%。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC and verbalize placement on AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识并口述 AVPU 定位：Alert（清醒）

expected.actionEn: Take manual in-line c-spine control BEFORE any movement or pain stimulus (MOI plus midline neck pain = NEXUS positive)
expected.actionZh: 在任何移动或疼痛刺激之前先徒手中线固定颈椎（受伤机制+中线颈痛=NEXUS 阳性）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway patency
expected.actionZh: 评估气道通畅性

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate, depth and effort
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸频率、深度与呼吸做功

expected.actionEn: Assess radial pulse rate, strength and regularity
expected.actionZh: 评估桡动脉搏动的频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Perform a full rapid body survey; find the wrist injury, expose it, check distal CSM and manually stabilize
expected.actionZh: 完成全身快速查体；发现腕部损伤并暴露，检查远端循环/感觉/活动，徒手固定

expected.actionEn: Note skin colour, temperature and condition
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤颜色、温度与状态

expected.actionEn: Check SpO2 and verbalize oxygen decision: 97% RA, titrate to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, no supplemental oxygen currently required
expected.actionZh: 查 SpO2 并口述给氧决策：室内空气 97%，目标维持 SpO2≥94%，目前无需吸氧

expected.actionEn: Keep the patient supine and still; explain why he must not move
expected.actionZh: 保持患者仰卧制动，并向其解释不能移动的原因

phases.infoEn: Decision point. No unstable findings: alert, strong radial pulse, normal skin, SpO2 97%, fall below the 6 m auto-RTC threshold, no neurological deficit. Correct decision: NON-RTC (stable). Assess, treat, package and be ready to load within 30 minutes. Secondary survey may be completed on scene.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。无不稳定表现：清醒、桡动脉有力、皮肤正常、SpO2 97%、坠落高度低于 6 米自动 RTC 阈值、无神经功能缺损。正确决策：非 RTC（稳定）。30 分钟内完成评估、处置、打包并可装载。二次评估可在现场完成。

expected.actionEn: Categorize correctly as non-RTC and manage accordingly
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC 并按其流程管理

expected.actionEn: Complete spinal packaging and splinting to be ready to load within 30 minutes, working with steady purpose
expected.actionZh: 在 30 分钟内完成脊柱打包与夹板固定并可装载，全程保持稳定的工作节奏

expected.actionEn: Delegate partner to bring spinal device, splint kit and cot; plan the egress route through the side gate
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档取脊柱固定装置、夹板包和担架床；规划经侧门的搬运路线

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS (only if asked): cleaning gutters, the ladder feet slipped; free fall about 4 m, landed flat on his back on concrete, head did not strike; no loss of consciousness; has not moved since landing. Neck pain 5/10, aching, non-radiating, worse with any attempted movement. Wrist pain 7/10, sharp. PMHx: none. Medications: none. Allergies: none known. Last oral intake: sandwich and coffee 1 hour ago. Wife confirms the fall was witnessed and he did not pass out.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员回答（仅在被问到时）：清理排水槽时梯脚打滑；约 4 米自由坠落，背部平摔在混凝土上，头部未撞击；无意识丧失；落地后未移动过。颈痛 5/10，酸痛、不放射、活动时加重。腕痛 7/10，锐痛。既往史：无。用药：无。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：1 小时前三明治和咖啡。妻子证实坠落全程被目击，患者未昏迷。

expected.actionEn: Clarify the chief complaint (neck pain vs wrist pain) directly with the patient
expected.actionZh: 与患者当面确认主诉（颈痛与腕痛孰为主）

expected.actionEn: Obtain HxC/C using OPQRRRST plus fall critical history: height, landing surface, what hit first, LOC, cause of fall, movement since
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST 加坠落关键病史采集现病史：高度、落地面、先着地部位、有无昏迷、坠落原因、事后是否移动

expected.actionEn: Obtain pain scores on a 0-10 scale for both complaints
expected.actionZh: 对两处疼痛均采集 0-10 疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: Obtain past medical history
expected.actionZh: 采集既往病史

expected.actionEn: Obtain medications
expected.actionZh: 采集用药史

expected.actionEn: Obtain allergies
expected.actionZh: 采集过敏史

expected.actionEn: Obtain last oral intake with time and size
expected.actionZh: 采集最后进食的时间和量

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (given only as each vital is properly assessed): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 128/82 auscultated; pulse 92 strong regular; respirations 18 regular good volume; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal and reactive, 4 mm; SpO2 97% RA. BGL and temperature are NOT indicated for this presentation. A full set must be completed in under 3 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（考生规范测量后逐项给出）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压听诊 128/82；脉搏 92 有力规则；呼吸 18 规则潮气量好；皮肤红润温暖干燥；瞳孔等大有反应，4 mm；SpO2 室内空气 97%。本表现不需要测血糖和体温。一整套生命体征须在 3 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: Assess GCS and verbalize component scores (E4 V5 M6 = 15)
expected.actionZh: 评估 GCS 并口述分项评分（E4 V5 M6 = 15）

expected.actionEn: Obtain BP by auscultation with correct cuff and stethoscope placement
expected.actionZh: 以正确袖带和听诊器位置听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Obtain pulse rate, strength and rhythm (convert to per-minute)
expected.actionZh: 测脉搏的频率、强度与节律（换算为每分钟）

expected.actionEn: Obtain respiratory rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 测呼吸频率、深度与性质

expected.actionEn: Physically assess skin colour, temperature, condition
expected.actionZh: 动手评估皮肤颜色、温度、状态

expected.actionEn: Assess pupils for size, equality and reactivity
expected.actionZh: 评估瞳孔大小、对称性与对光反应

expected.actionEn: Obtain SpO2 and confirm oximeter reading calibrates with palpated pulse
expected.actionZh: 测 SpO2 并确认血氧仪读数与触诊脉搏一致

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY (EMR player skips this phase). ACTOR ANSWERS: general health good; CNS - no headache, dizziness, numbness, tingling or weakness in any limb; respiratory - no SOB; cardiovascular - no chest pain or palpitations; GI/GU - no abdominal pain, no incontinence; integumentary - nil except wrist swelling; musculoskeletal - neck and right wrist pain only; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - no visual change, no blood or fluid from ears/nose.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP（EMR 播放器跳过此幕）。患者演员回答：整体健康良好；中枢神经——无头痛、头晕，四肢无麻木、刺痛或无力；呼吸——无气促；心血管——无胸痛心悸；消化/泌尿——无腹痛、无失禁；皮肤——除腕部肿胀外无异常；肌肉骨骼——仅颈部和右腕疼痛；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无视觉改变，耳鼻无出血或液体。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health and recent illness
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康与近期疾病

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS: headache, dizziness, numbness, tingling, weakness (critical with spinal MOI)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经：头痛/头晕/麻木/刺痛/无力（脊柱伤机制下为重点）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory system
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular system
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管系统

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU: abdominal pain, incontinence
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿：腹痛、失禁

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary system
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal system
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine system
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌系统

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe findings (give per region examined): head/neck - midline tenderness C5-C6, no deformity, no fluid from ears/nose, mouth clear; chest - no DOTS, equal air entry with clear breath sounds in all 6 auscultation sites; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - to be assessed during the roll onto the spinal device, no thoracolumbar tenderness or deformity; lower extremities - no injury, CSM intact bilaterally; upper extremities - right wrist deformity as found, CSM intact, left arm unremarkable.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚查体发现（按考生检查的区域给出）：头颈——C5-C6 中线压痛，无畸形，耳鼻无液体，口腔干净；胸部——无 DOTS，6 个听诊点空气进入对称、呼吸音清；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——在滚动上脊柱板时检查，胸腰段无压痛无畸形；下肢——无损伤，双侧远端循环感觉活动完好；上肢——右腕畸形同前，远端 CSM 完好，左臂无异常。

expected.actionEn: Examine head and neck (DOTS, ears/nose fluid, mouth)
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈（DOTS、耳鼻液体、口腔）

expected.actionEn: Examine and auscultate chest in at least 6 sites, comparing bilaterally through inspiration and expiration
expected.actionZh: 检查并听诊胸部至少 6 个部位，双侧对比、听完吸气与呼气相

expected.actionEn: Examine abdomen (inspect and palpate four quadrants)
expected.actionZh: 检查腹部（视诊并触诊四个象限）

expected.actionEn: Examine the back during the coordinated roll, maintaining spinal alignment
expected.actionZh: 在保持脊柱轴线的协同滚动中检查背部

expected.actionEn: Examine lower extremities including pelvis, with distal CSM
expected.actionZh: 检查下肢（含骨盆），并查远端循环感觉活动

expected.actionEn: Examine upper extremities with distal CSM comparison in both hands
expected.actionZh: 检查上肢并对比双手远端循环感觉活动

phases.infoEn: Skills to physically perform: sized hard collar while manual stabilization is maintained; coordinated roll or scoop onto the spinal device with the candidate controlling the head; head blocks and straps - body secured before head, do NOT tape the head. Pain Management protocol BEFORE splinting/movement: PCP - acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO on-boarded early, plus Entonox self-administered during packaging and splinting (rule out contraindications for each: liver disease/recent doses; GI bleed/anticoagulants/pregnancy; pneumothorax/ALOC/inability to comply). EMR - Entonox only. Then splint the right wrist in position found (distal pulse present, no realignment needed), pad, immobilize joint above and below, apply cold 10 minutes on / 5 off, reassess distal CSM before and after.
phases.infoZh: 需实际操作的技能：在持续徒手固定下量取并上硬质颈托；由考生控制头部，协同滚动或铲式担架移上脊柱固定装置；头部固定块与绑带——先固定躯干后固定头部，禁止用胶带缠头。移动/夹板前先启动疼痛管理协议：PCP——尽早口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 和布洛芬 400 mg，打包与夹板期间让患者自控吸入 Entonox（逐药排除禁忌：肝病/近期已服用；消化道出血/抗凝药/妊娠；气胸/意识改变/无法配合）。EMR——仅 Entonox。然后按原位夹板固定右腕（远端脉搏存在，无需复位），加衬垫，固定上下关节，冰敷 10 分钟敷 5 分钟停，夹板前后复查远端循环感觉活动。

expected.actionEn: Apply a correctly sized hard collar without losing manual stabilization
expected.actionZh: 在不丢失徒手固定的前提下上尺寸正确的硬质颈托

expected.actionEn: Package onto the spinal device: coordinated roll, neutral alignment, body strapped before head, no head tape
expected.actionZh: 打包上脊柱固定装置：协同滚动、中立位对线、先绑躯干后固定头部、不用胶带缠头

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Pain Management protocol with baseline vitals done and contraindications ruled out BEFORE splinting or movement
expected.actionZh: 在夹板固定或移动之前，于基线生命体征完成、禁忌排除后启动疼痛管理协议

expected.actionEn: Administer analgesia with the 6 rights (PCP: acetaminophen 1000 mg PO + ibuprofen 400 mg PO + Entonox; EMR: Entonox, invert cylinder 3 times)
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对给药（PCP：对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服+布洛芬 400 mg 口服+Entonox；EMR：Entonox，先倒转气瓶 3 次）

expected.actionEn: Splint the wrist with padding, joints above and below immobilized, cold applied 10-on/5-off, distal CSM rechecked before and after
expected.actionZh: 腕部夹板：加衬垫、固定上下关节、冰敷 10 敷 5 停、夹板前后复查远端循环感觉活动

phases.infoEn: Reassess after every major move (roll, lift to cot, load). Set 2 vitals (after analgesia and packaging): GCS 15; BP 124/80; pulse 84 strong regular; respirations 16; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 98% RA; neck pain 3/10, wrist pain 3/10. Non-RTC vitals interval: next set no later than about 15 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 每次大的移动（滚动、抬上担架床、装车）后复评。第 2 组生命体征（镇痛与打包后）：GCS 15；血压 124/80；脉搏 84 有力规则；呼吸 16；皮肤红润温暖干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 98%；颈痛 3/10，腕痛 3/10。非 RTC 生命体征间隔：与第一组相隔不超过约 15 分钟。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions (collar, straps, splint, distal CSM) after each major move
expected.actionZh: 每次大移动后复评 ABC 及所有处置（颈托、绑带、夹板、远端循环感觉活动）

expected.actionEn: Complete a full second set of vitals within the non-RTC interval
expected.actionZh: 在非 RTC 时限内完成完整的第二组生命体征

expected.actionEn: Reassess pain scores after analgesia and titrate Entonox to effect
expected.actionZh: 镇痛后复评疼痛评分，并按效果滴定 Entonox

phases.infoEn: Give a structured verbal hand-off at the hospital, then complete the PCR within 5 minutes. The hand-off must include: age/sex, chief complaint, MOI, history of chief complaint, initial and final vitals, PMHx, medications, allergies, treatments given, relevant findings.
phases.infoZh: 到院后进行结构化口头交接，随后 5 分钟内完成 PCR。交接必须包含：年龄/性别、主诉、受伤机制、现病史、首末两组生命体征、既往史、用药、过敏、已行处置、相关阳性发现。

expected.actionEn: Notify the receiving hospital en route with a concise report
expected.actionZh: 途中向接收医院进行简明预报

expected.actionEn: Deliver a complete, organized hand-off report covering all required elements
expected.actionZh: 交付完整、有条理、涵盖全部要素的交接报告

expected.actionEn: Submit a legible, accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内提交字迹清楚、内容准确的 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Moving the patient or applying any pain stimulus before manual c-spine control - 100% (Delicate Spine)
Releasing c-spine control before the patient is fully secured to the device - 100%
No rapid body survey, or finding the wrist injury and not stabilizing it - 100% (RBS)
PCP: on-boarding acetaminophen/ibuprofen but delaying Entonox until after splinting or movement - 100% (Pain Management, Appendix A)
Initiating the analgesia protocol without baseline vitals or without ruling out contraindications - up to 100% (Protocols)
criticalPitfallsZh: 徒手固定颈椎之前移动患者或施加疼痛刺激——扣 100%（Delicate Spine）
患者尚未完全固定在装置上就松开颈椎固定——扣 100%
不做快速查体，或发现腕部损伤却不固定——扣 100%（RBS）
PCP：已给对乙酰氨基酚/布洛芬，却把 Entonox 拖到夹板/移动之后——扣 100%（疼痛管理附录 A）
未完成基线生命体征或未排除禁忌就启动镇痛协议——最高扣 100%（Protocols）
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR carries no oral analgesics: pain management is Entonox only (rule out pneumothorax, ALOC, inability to comply; invert cylinder 3 times). No Functional Enquiry phase. All spinal and fracture skills are identical to PCP.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 没有口服镇痛药：疼痛管理只用 Entonox（排除气胸、意识改变、无法配合；气瓶倒转 3 次）。无功能问诊幕。脊柱与骨折技能与 PCP 完全相同。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the full 9-system Functional Enquiry and the three-drug analgesia ladder: acetaminophen 500-1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 300-400 mg PO on-boarded early, Entonox during packaging/splinting. Appendix A weighting applies: omitting Entonox when indicated after giving the oral agents, or sequencing it after fracture management, is a 100% error.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加 9 系统功能问诊和三联镇痛阶梯：尽早口服对乙酰氨基酚 500-1000 mg 和布洛芬 300-400 mg，打包/夹板期间用 Entonox。适用附录 A 权重：给了口服药却在有指征时不给 Entonox，或把 Entonox 排到骨折处理之后，都是 100% 级错误。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is Mark, a 34-year-old male, chief complaint of midline neck pain and right wrist pain after a witnessed 4-metre fall from a ladder, landing flat on his back on concrete, no loss of consciousness, not moved since landing. Initial vitals: GCS 15, BP 128/82, pulse 92 strong regular, resps 18, skin pink warm dry, pupils equal and reactive, SpO2 97% on room air; latest set BP 124/80, pulse 84, pain down from 7 to 3 after analgesia. No past medical history, no medications, no known allergies, last ate one hour ago. Findings: midline C5-C6 tenderness, dorsally deformed right wrist with distal CSM intact throughout. Treatments: manual c-spine then collar and full spinal immobilization, right wrist splinted with cold applied, acetaminophen 1000 mg PO, ibuprofen 400 mg PO and Entonox prior to movement.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 Mark，34 岁男性，主诉为目击下从梯子约 4 米坠落、背部平摔在混凝土上后的颈部中线疼痛和右腕疼痛，无意识丧失，落地后未移动。首组生命体征：GCS 15，血压 128/82，脉搏 92 有力规则，呼吸 18，皮肤红润温暖干燥，瞳孔等大有反应，SpO2 室内空气 97%；末组血压 124/80，脉搏 84，镇痛后疼痛由 7 分降至 3 分。无既往史、无用药、无已知过敏，1 小时前进食。发现：C5-C6 中线压痛，右腕背侧畸形，远端循环感觉活动全程完好。处置：徒手固定颈椎后上颈托并全脊柱固定，右腕夹板加冰敷，移动前给予对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服、布洛芬 400 mg 口服及 Entonox。

findings: Midline C5-C6 tenderness

Vitals stable both sets

scenarios.titleEn: High-Risk MVA - Blunt Abdominal Trauma With Shock
scenarios.titleZh: 高风险车祸——腹部钝性伤合并休克
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1740 hrs. Code 3 to the intersection of No. 3 Road and Westminster Highway, Richmond, for a two-vehicle collision. Fire and police are on scene. Your patient is the 45-year-old male driver of a sedan T-boned on the driver side at an estimated 60 km/h. Hospital is 10 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 17:40，Code 3 前往列治文 No. 3 Road 与 Westminster Highway 路口两车相撞现场。消防和警察已在现场。你的患者是被以约 60 km/h T 字撞击驾驶侧的轿车司机，45 岁男性。医院车程 10 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Rush-hour traffic. Fire reports the patient is out of the vehicle, lying on a blanket on the road, awake. No entrapment.
phases.infoZh: 晚高峰车流。消防报告患者已离开车辆，躺在路面毯子上，清醒。无困陷。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge dispatch; anticipate a high-risk MVA: spinal equipment, oxygen, trauma kit, early transport mindset
expected.actionZh: 确认派遣；预判高风险车祸：脊柱装备、氧气、创伤包，树立尽早转运意识

expected.actionEn: Anticipate hazards: traffic, glass, leaking fluids; plan PPE
expected.actionZh: 预判危险源：车流、玻璃、泄漏液体；计划个人防护

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Police have closed the lane; fire has controlled leaking fluids and disconnected the battery. The sedan has 0.4 m of intrusion into the driver door. Airbags deployed. The patient, extricated by fire, lies supine on a blanket 5 metres from the wreck, pale, holding his left side. One patient - the other driver has refused care and is with police. Daylight, dry road, 18 degrees C.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：警察已封闭车道；消防已控制泄漏液体并断开电瓶。轿车驾驶侧车门内陷 0.4 米。安全气囊已弹出。患者由消防移出，仰卧在距残骸 5 米的毯子上，面色苍白，手捂左侧腹。单一患者——另一司机拒绝救治，正与警察在一起。白天，路面干燥，18 摄氏度。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (traffic, glass, fluids controlled), environment, MOI (60 km/h T-bone, 0.4 m intrusion = high-risk auto crash) and number of patients
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（车流、玻璃、液体已控制）、环境、受伤机制（60 km/h T 字撞击、0.4 米内陷=高风险车祸）及患者数量

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: pale male, supine, guarding his left flank, talking
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：苍白男性，仰卧，护住左侧腹，能说话

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert but anxious, answers in short sentences, complains of severe left upper abdominal pain. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 24, shallow; radial pulse present but weak and rapid at 124. Skin (during RBS): pale, cool, clammy. RBS: seatbelt bruising across chest and abdomen; LUQ tender and guarded; pelvis stable on single gentle assessment; no external hemorrhage; no long bone fractures. SpO2 91% RA. This patient is UNSTABLE (weak rapid pulse, cool pale clammy skin = suspected shock).
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒但焦虑，只能短句回答，主诉左上腹剧痛。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 24 次/分、浅；桡动脉可及但细速，124 次/分。皮肤（RBS 时给出）：苍白、湿冷。RBS：胸腹部安全带瘀痕；左上腹压痛伴肌卫；骨盆单次轻柔检查稳定；无外出血；无长骨骨折。SpO2 室内空气 91%。该患者为不稳定（细速脉+苍白湿冷皮肤=疑似休克）。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC and verbalize AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识并口述 AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: Take manual c-spine control immediately (high-risk MOI)
expected.actionZh: 立即徒手固定颈椎（高风险受伤机制）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing; expose the chest given the MOI
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸；按受伤机制暴露胸部

expected.actionEn: Assess radial pulse; recognize weak rapid pulse as shock
expected.actionZh: 评估桡动脉；识别细速脉为休克表现

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey: find seatbelt sign and tender guarded LUQ; single gentle pelvis check only
expected.actionZh: 快速查体：发现安全带征和左上腹压痛肌卫；骨盆仅做单次轻柔检查

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale cool clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白湿冷

expected.actionEn: Apply high-flow oxygen (15 L/min NRB) for shock and SpO2 91%
expected.actionZh: 因休克且 SpO2 91% 给高流量吸氧（非再吸入面罩 15 L/min）

expected.actionEn: Keep supine to support blood pressure; blanket for warmth; limit movement to reduce clot disruption
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧以维持血压；盖毯保暖；限制移动以减少血凝块破坏

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Unstable: suspected shock with high-risk MOI. Correct decision: RTC. Package on a spinal device and be ready to load within 15 minutes with clear urgency. History, remaining vitals and the head-to-toe are completed EN ROUTE.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。不稳定：高风险机制下疑似休克。正确决策：RTC。15 分钟内完成脊柱装置打包并可装载，动作要有紧迫感。病史、其余生命体征与从头到脚查体在转运途中完成。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并以紧迫节奏执行

expected.actionEn: Assess, package (spinal device, secured) and be ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内完成评估、打包（脊柱装置、固定妥当）并可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate fire/partner: cot to patient, egress cleared, notify en route
expected.actionZh: 指派消防/搭档：担架床推到患者旁、清出撤离通道、途中预报医院

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE. ACTOR ANSWERS: driver, lap-shoulder belt worn, airbags deployed; other car hit his door at speed; he was dazed but thinks he did not lose consciousness; fire moved him out. Pain 8/10 LUQ, sharp, worse with breathing, non-radiating, started at impact. PMHx: hypertension. Meds: ramipril 5 mg daily. Allergies: penicillin (rash). LOI: coffee 2 hours ago. MVA critical history is available from fire/police if asked: single impact, no fatality, moderate cabin intrusion 0.4 m.
phases.infoZh: 转运途中。患者演员回答：司机，系三点式安全带，气囊弹出；对方车辆高速撞上他的车门；当时发懵但自认没有昏迷；由消防移出车外。疼痛 8/10，左上腹锐痛，呼吸时加重，不放射，撞击时开始。既往史：高血压。用药：雷米普利 5 mg 每日。过敏：青霉素（皮疹）。最后进食：2 小时前咖啡。向消防/警察询问可得车祸关键病史：单次撞击、无死亡、驾驶舱内陷 0.4 米。

expected.actionEn: Confirm chief complaint: left upper abdominal pain
expected.actionZh: 确认主诉：左上腹痛

expected.actionEn: Obtain HxC/C with OPQRRRST plus MVA critical history (speed, intrusion, restraints, airbags, LOC, other occupants)
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST 加车祸关键病史（车速、内陷、约束装置、气囊、昏迷、其他乘员）采集现病史

expected.actionEn: Obtain pain score 0-10
expected.actionZh: 采集 0-10 疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: Obtain PMHx (hypertension)
expected.actionZh: 采集既往史（高血压）

expected.actionEn: Obtain medications (ramipril)
expected.actionZh: 采集用药（雷米普利）

expected.actionEn: Obtain allergies (penicillin - rash)
expected.actionZh: 采集过敏史（青霉素——皮疹）

expected.actionEn: Obtain LOI
expected.actionZh: 采集最后进食

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (given as assessed): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 88/62; pulse 124 weak regular; respirations 24 shallow; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 94% on 15 L NRB (was 91% RA). BGL and temperature not indicated. RTC patient: repeat vitals within 5-6 minutes; over 9 minutes between sets is a major deficiency.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（按评估给出）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 88/62；脉搏 124 细弱规则；呼吸 24 浅；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 在 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 94%（室内空气时 91%）。血糖和体温无指征。RTC 患者：5-6 分钟内复测生命体征；两组间隔超过 9 分钟属重大缺陷。

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - recognize 88/62 as hypotension
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——识别 88/62 为低血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength, rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度、节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate, depth, character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率、深度、性质

expected.actionEn: Skin reassessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手复评皮肤

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration check against pulse
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并与触诊脉搏校准

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, kept brief for the unstable patient. ACTOR: general health good; CNS - no headache, no numbness; respiratory - pain on deep breath, no SOB at rest; cardiovascular - no chest pain; GI/GU - severe LUQ pain, felt faint on standing (fire lifted him); nauseated; integumentary - seatbelt bruising; musculoskeletal - left ribs sore; endocrine - nil; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，转运途中，对不稳定患者从简。患者演员：整体健康好；中枢神经——无头痛无麻木；呼吸——深吸气痛，静息无气促；心血管——无胸痛；消化/泌尿——左上腹剧痛，站立时曾觉眩晕（由消防抬出）；恶心；皮肤——安全带瘀痕；肌肉骨骼——左侧肋部酸痛；内分泌——无；眼耳鼻喉——无。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe (give per region): head/neck - no DOTS, trachea midline; chest - seatbelt bruise left chest, tender left lower ribs, equal air entry all 6 sites, no crepitus; abdomen - LUQ guarding and tenderness, increasing distension; back - checked during roll onto device on scene, no deformity; lower extremities - nil, CSM intact; upper extremities - nil, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚查体（按区域给出）：头颈——无 DOTS，气管居中；胸部——左胸安全带瘀痕、左下肋压痛、6 个听诊点空气进入对称、无骨擦感；腹部——左上腹肌卫压痛、腹胀渐增；背部——现场滚动上板时已查、无畸形；下肢——无异常、CSM 完好；上肢——无异常、CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation, bilateral comparison
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam - recognize increasing distension as ongoing bleed

expected.actionZh: 下肢（含骨盆回顾）及 CSM

expected.actionZh: 上肢及 CSM

phases.infoEn: Treatments: spinal packaging done on scene (collar, device, body before head). Hypovolemia protocol for all levels: supine, warmth, high-flow O2, limit movement, rapid transport. PCP EN ROUTE: vascular access 18 G, normal saline fluid bolus 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL, target systolic BP 90; TXA 2 g (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute - indicated (signs of shock with MOI suggesting occult bleeding, under 3 hours, over 12 years old, not an isolated TBI). EMR: no IV/TXA - supportive shock care and rapid conveyance.
phases.infoZh: 处置：脊柱打包已在现场完成（颈托、装置、先躯干后头部）。各级别低血容量协议：仰卧、保暖、高流量吸氧、限制移动、快速转运。PCP 途中：18 G 静脉通路，生理盐水 20 mL/kg 快速补液、上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评、目标收缩压 90；TXA 2 g（2000 mg）静推 1 分钟——有指征（休克征象+机制提示隐匿出血、伤后不足 3 小时、大于 12 岁、非孤立性颅脑伤）。EMR：无静脉/TXA——支持性抗休克处理并快速转运。

expected.actionEn: Execute the Hypovolemia protocol: supine, warm, high-flow O2, minimal movement, no delay on scene
expected.actionZh: 执行低血容量协议：仰卧、保暖、高流量吸氧、尽量少动、现场不滞留

expected.actionEn: Spinal packaging skill performed correctly
expected.actionZh: 脊柱打包技能操作正确

expected.actionEn: PCP: IV access and 20 mL/kg bolus (max 2 L), reassess every 500 mL against target SBP 90
expected.actionZh: PCP：建立静脉通路并 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升），每 500 mL 按目标收缩压 90 复评

expected.actionEn: PCP: TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute with 6 rights and contraindications ruled out (time of injury, age, allergy, isolated TBI)
expected.actionZh: PCP：TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟，六项核对并排除禁忌（受伤时间、年龄、过敏、孤立性颅脑伤）

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after loading and after every 500 mL of fluid. Set 2 (en route): GCS 15 but increasingly anxious; BP 84/58; pulse 132 weak; respirations 26; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal; SpO2 95% on 15 L. The patient is deteriorating - continue bolus, keep warm, early hospital notification.
phases.infoZh: 装车后及每输注 500 mL 后复评 ABC 与各项处置。第 2 组（途中）：GCS 15 但愈发焦虑；血压 84/58；脉搏 132 细弱；呼吸 26；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 下 95%。患者在恶化——继续补液、保暖、尽早通知医院。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each major move and each 500 mL
expected.actionZh: 每次大移动及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC 与处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes; recognize the deteriorating trend
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征；识别恶化趋势

expected.actionEn: Continue the fluid protocol correctly against the SBP 90 target (PCP)
expected.actionZh: 按收缩压 90 目标正确继续补液协议（PCP）

phases.infoEn: Critical patient: the hospital must be notified en route. Structured hand-off on arrival; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者：必须在途中通知医院。到院后结构化交接；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Early en-route notification for a critical patient
expected.actionZh: 危重患者尽早途中预报

expected.actionEn: Complete organized hand-off with initial and final vitals and treatment response
expected.actionZh: 完整有序交接，含首末生命体征与治疗反应

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Not recognizing shock and staying on scene beyond 15 minutes for a full secondary - RTC timing failure (25%) and can cascade to protocol failures
No c-spine control with a high-risk MVA mechanism - 100%
No rapid body survey / missing the abdominal life threat - 100%
Repeatedly springing or rocking the pelvis - patient care deduction; one gentle assessment only
PCP: giving TXA without confirming time of injury under 3 hours, or running fluid without reassessing every 500 mL - protocol errors up to 100%
criticalPitfallsZh: 不识别休克、为做完整二次评估在现场滞留超过 15 分钟——RTC 时限失分（25%）并可连锁引发协议失分
高风险车祸机制下不做颈椎固定——扣 100%
不做快速查体/漏掉腹部致命伤——扣 100%
反复摇晃或按压骨盆——患者照护扣分；只允许单次轻柔检查
PCP：未确认受伤时间在 3 小时内就给 TXA，或补液不做每 500 mL 复评——协议类错误最高扣 100%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: no vascular access, no TXA. The station is won on shock recognition, supine positioning, warmth, high-flow oxygen, 15-minute packaging and en-route reassessment. Secondary survey en route.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：无静脉通路、无 TXA。本题得分点在于识别休克、仰卧位、保暖、高流量吸氧、15 分钟内打包和途中复评。二次评估在途中完成。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds en-route vascular access (18 G), 20 mL/kg NS bolus to max 2 L reassessing every 500 mL (target SBP 90), and TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute for shock with suspected occult bleeding. Functional Enquiry en route, kept efficient.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路（18 G）、生理盐水 20 mL/kg 补液上限 2 升每 500 mL 复评（目标收缩压 90），以及针对疑似隐匿出血休克的 TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟。功能问诊在途中高效完成。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 45-year-old male, restrained driver of a sedan T-boned on his door at about 60 km/h with 0.4 metres of intrusion, airbags deployed, no confirmed LOC. Chief complaint is severe left upper quadrant abdominal pain with seatbelt bruising, guarding and increasing distension - we are treating this as intra-abdominal bleeding with shock. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 88/62, pulse 124 weak, resps 24 shallow, skin pale cool clammy, SpO2 94% on 15 litres; latest BP 84/58, pulse 132 - he is trending down. History of hypertension on ramipril, allergic to penicillin, coffee two hours ago. Treatments: c-spine and full spinal packaging, high-flow oxygen, kept supine and warm, rapid transport; IV 18 G with a saline bolus running, 1 litre in, and TXA 2 grams IV given at 25 minutes post-injury.

phases.infoEn: Skills: chest seal applied correctly (wound cleaned edge, seal burped of air, vented/3-sided so air can escape). criticalPitfallsEn: Not exposing the chest / not finding and sealing the sucking wound in the primary - 100% (Breathing / RBS)
Taping an occlusive dressing on all four sides with no vent and not monitoring - creates tension pneumothorax; failure to relieve it is a 100% protocol error
Not checking the back for an exit wound - explicit rubric deduction
Giving Entonox to a chest-trauma patient (pneumothorax contraindication) - protocol error up to 100%
Applying c-spine immobilization when not indicated - unnecessary skill causing delay (deduction) and slows the RTC clock
criticalPitfallsZh: 不暴露胸部/初评中未发现并封闭吸吮性伤口——扣 100%（Breathing / RBS）
四边全封且不留排气、之后又不监测——制造张力性气胸；不解除即为 100% 协议错误
不检查背部出口伤——评分细则明确扣分项
给胸部创伤患者使用 Entonox（气胸禁忌）——协议错误最高扣 100%
无指征地做颈椎固定——非指征技能造成延误（扣分）并拖慢 RTC 时限

phases.infoEn: Treatments: once the patient is stabilized, preserve the (near-)amputated part: rinse gross debris with cool sterile water, wrap loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, place in a plastic bag, keep the bag cool in a protective container, transport WITH the patient. Never warm it, never immerse in water, never place directly on ice, never use dry ice. Hypovolemia protocol: supine, warmth, O2. PCP EN ROUTE: vascular access on the right arm; fluid bolus 20 mL/kg max 2 L reassessing q500 mL (SBP target 90); TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute - indicated (shock from blood loss, well under 3 hours). Analgesia: Entonox is CAUTIONED in shock - withhold and document rationale.
phases.infoZh: 处置：患者稳定后保存（近）离断部分：用冷的无菌水冲去大块污物，用生理盐水湿润的无菌纱布松松包裹，装入塑料袋，袋子放入保护容器中保持低温，随患者一同转运。绝不加温、绝不泡水、绝不直接放冰上、绝不用干冰。低血容量协议：仰卧、保暖、吸氧。PCP 途中：右臂建立静脉通路；补液 20 mL/kg 上限 2 升每 500 mL 复评（目标收缩压 90）；TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟——有指征（失血性休克，远在 3 小时内）。镇痛：休克为 Entonox 慎用情形——暂不给并记录理由。

criticalPitfallsEn: Finding life-threatening hemorrhage and failing to control it, or long delay before the tourniquet - 100% (RBS)
Releasing or loosening the tourniquet once applied - 100%
Not noting the tourniquet time - critical information failure carried into records deductions
Placing the part directly on ice, in water, or warming it - part-preservation errors (skill deductions)
PCP: skipping the reassessment every 500 mL during the bolus, or TXA outside its indications - protocol errors up to 100%
criticalPitfallsZh: 发现致命性大出血却未控制，或上止血带前拖延过久——扣 100%（RBS）

不记录止血带时间——关键信息缺失并延伸到记录类扣分

PCP：补液不做每 500 mL 复评，或超出指征使用 TXA——协议类错误最高扣 100%

scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 52-year-old male with a near-complete amputation of the left hand just proximal to the wrist from a table saw at approximately 0957, arterial bleeding uncontrolled by direct pressure. A tourniquet was applied to the left forearm at 1012 and has not been released. Estimated 700 mL blood loss on scene. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 96/64, pulse 122 weak, resps 22, skin pale cool clammy, SpO2 95% on 15 litres, BGL 7.8; latest BP 102/66, pulse 114 after one litre of saline. History of type 2 diabetes and dyslipidemia on metformin and atorvastatin, allergic to sulfa. Treatments: tourniquet at 1012, pressure dressing, supine with warmth, high-flow oxygen, IV with saline bolus running, TXA 2 grams IV at 1025, and the amputated part is wrapped in saline-moistened gauze, bagged and kept cool, transported with him.

phases.infoEn: Burn Management: cool 15-20 minutes total with cool (not cold) running water, inclusive of bystander cooling; monitor for hypothermia and keep the rest of the body covered; do NOT break blisters, do NOT apply creams, ointments or ice. AFTER cooling is complete, dress with sterile, non-stick, DRY gauze. Pain Management protocol: PCP - acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO plus Entonox self-administered (Entonox is indicated for pain associated with burns; contraindicated with inhalation injury - here there is none). EMR - Entonox only. Reassess distal CSM in the burned limb before and after dressing.
phases.infoZh: 烧伤处理：用凉（非冰）流水降温总计 15-20 分钟，含旁观者已完成时间；监测低体温并盖好身体其余部位；不要挑破水疱，不要涂抹药膏、油膏或冰敷。降温结束后用无菌、不粘、干燥纱布包扎。疼痛管理协议：PCP——对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服加布洛芬 400 mg 口服，并让患者自控吸入 Entonox（Entonox 适用于烧伤相关疼痛；吸入性损伤为禁忌，本例没有）。EMR——仅 Entonox。包扎前后复查烧伤肢体远端 CSM。

criticalPitfallsEn: Applying ice or very cold water, or cooling well beyond 20 minutes and making the patient hypothermic - protocol error up to 100%
Dressing the burn before cooling is complete, or using wet/creamed/ointment dressings instead of dry non-stick gauze - wound management error 25%
Breaking blisters - wound management error
Not assessing the airway for inhalation injury (voice, soot, singed hair) - 100% (Airway)
PCP: giving acetaminophen and ibuprofen but omitting Entonox when indicated - 25% per Appendix A; delaying Entonox until after painful dressing changes - up to 100%

降温未完成就包扎，或用湿敷料/药膏而非干燥不粘纱布——伤口处理错误扣 25%

scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 29-year-old male with a boiling-water scald to the right upper limb and anterior chest sustained at approximately 1144 in a commercial kitchen. Using the Rule of Nines this is 18 percent partial thickness - 9 percent for the whole right arm and 9 percent for the anterior chest - with blistering, no full-thickness area, no circumferential burn and no airway involvement: voice is clear, no soot, no singed nasal hair, no facial burn. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 138/84, pulse 108, resps 22, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 36.4; latest BP 130/80, pulse 96, temperature 36.1, pain down from 9 to 4 out of 10. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, ate one hour before. Treatments: 20 minutes total of cool running water cooling including the 4 minutes staff provided, wet clothing and his watch removed, sterile dry non-stick dressings after cooling, blankets to prevent hypothermia, acetaminophen 1000 milligrams and ibuprofen 400 milligrams orally plus Entonox for pain. Distal circulation, sensation and function in the right arm have been intact throughout.

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Dark pathway lit by police flashlights and your scene lights. Wet grass, 9 degrees C, light rain. A baseball bat has been secured by police as evidence. The patient lies on his left side on the grass where he fell; a bystander rolled him there because he vomited. One patient. Police remain with you.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：步道昏暗，靠警灯和你们的现场灯照明。草地潮湿，9 摄氏度，小雨。棒球棒已由警方作为证物封存。患者左侧卧在跌倒处的草地上；因为他吐过，一名旁观者把他翻成侧卧。单一患者。警察全程在场。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (dark, wet, cold, assault scene - police present), environment, MOI (blunt head trauma with bat), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（黑暗、潮湿、寒冷、袭击现场——警察在场）、环境、受伤机制（棒球棒钝性头部伤）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection (blood and vomit)
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜（有血液与呕吐物）

expected.actionEn: First look: patient on his side, moaning, blood in the hair on the right temple, vomit beside him
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：患者侧卧、呻吟、右侧颞部头发上有血、身旁有呕吐物

expected.actionEn: Protect from the environment: get the patient off the cold wet ground promptly and shield from rain
expected.actionZh: 环境防护：尽快让患者脱离冰冷潮湿地面并遮挡雨水

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: eyes open to voice, confused speech ('where... where is... my bag'), obeys simple commands slowly. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - vomit in the mouth requiring SUCTION (10-15 seconds in an adult) and ongoing airway monitoring; respirations 14, adequate depth; radial pulse 58, strong and bounding. Skin: pale, warm, dry. RBS: 6 cm boggy swelling and laceration over the right temporal scalp with slow venous bleeding, no depressed skull fracture felt, no CSF from ears or nose, no other injuries. SpO2 93% RA. UNSTABLE: altered LOC with head trauma.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：呼唤能睁眼，言语错乱（「我的…我的包呢…」），能缓慢执行简单指令。考官（评估时给出）：气道——口腔内有呕吐物，需吸引（成人 10-15 秒）并持续监测气道；呼吸 14 次/分、深度尚可；桡动脉 58 次/分、有力洪大。皮肤：苍白、温暖、干燥。RBS：右颞部头皮有 6 cm 松软肿胀伴裂伤、缓慢静脉性出血，未触及凹陷性骨折，耳鼻无脑脊液流出，无其他损伤。SpO2 室内空气 93%。不稳定：头部外伤伴意识改变。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Voice, confused - a decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：对言语有反应、言语错乱——意识下降

expected.actionEn: Take manual c-spine control immediately - blunt head trauma with altered LOC is a NEXUS-positive indication
expected.actionZh: 立即徒手固定颈椎——钝性头部外伤伴意识改变属 NEXUS 阳性指征

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and SUCTION the vomit; keep the airway clear throughout
expected.actionZh: 评估气道并吸引呕吐物；全程保持气道通畅

expected.actionEn: Consider and correctly size an airway adjunct (OPA only if the gag reflex is absent; NPA is an option if not contraindicated)
expected.actionZh: 考虑并正确选择气道辅助装置（无咽反射才用口咽通气道；无禁忌时可考虑鼻咽通气道）

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate and adequacy; be ready to assist ventilations if the rate falls
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸频率与是否足够；一旦频率下降立即准备辅助通气

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - recognize bradycardia with a bounding pulse as a possible rising-ICP sign
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——识别心动过缓伴洪大脉搏可能提示颅内压升高

expected.actionEn: Complete the RBS; control scalp bleeding with direct pressure; palpate for depressed skull fracture and check ears/nose for fluid
expected.actionZh: 完成快速查体；直接加压控制头皮出血；触诊有无凹陷性骨折并检查耳鼻有无液体

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale warm dry
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、温暖、干燥

expected.actionEn: Apply oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94% - TBI patients must not be allowed to desaturate
expected.actionZh: 给氧维持 SpO2≥94%——颅脑损伤患者绝不能出现氧饱和度下降

expected.actionEn: Manage position: spinal precautions with the head of the bed elevated 30 degrees once packaged, and airway protection given the vomiting
expected.actionZh: 体位管理：脊柱防护下打包后床头抬高 30 度，并针对呕吐做好气道保护

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Altered LOC after head trauma = UNSTABLE, RTC. Package with spinal precautions and be ready to load within 15 minutes. Destination: this patient meets trauma-centre criteria for a moderate TBI; verbalize the destination decision and notify.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。头部外伤后意识改变=不稳定，RTC。按脊柱防护打包，15 分钟内可装载。目的地：本例符合中度颅脑损伤的创伤中心标准；需口述目的地决策并预报。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes with the airway managed
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内在气道已管理的前提下打包完毕可装载

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the trauma-centre destination decision and notify early
expected.actionZh: 口述送往创伤中心的决策并尽早预报

phases.infoEn: ACTOR is confused - use POLICE AND WITNESSES: struck once on the right side of the head with a bat about 15 minutes ago, fell backwards onto grass, unconscious for roughly 2 minutes, then awake but confused and vomited twice. No other blows seen. He cannot describe the pain reliably; when asked he says his head hurts, maybe 6/10. PMHx (from his wife by phone): none significant, no anticoagulants. Meds: none. Allergies: none known. LOI: dinner around 1900, two beers.
phases.infoZh: 患者意识错乱——需向警察和目击者采集：约 15 分钟前右侧头部被棒球棒击中一次，向后倒在草地上，昏迷约 2 分钟，随后清醒但意识错乱并呕吐两次。未见其他击打。他无法可靠描述疼痛；被问及时称头痛，大约 6/10。既往史（电话联系其妻获得）：无重要病史，未服抗凝药。用药：无。过敏：无已知。最后进食：约 19:00 晚餐，两瓶啤酒。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: head injury with altered mental status
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：头部损伤伴精神状态改变

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from witnesses: number of blows, weapon, duration of LOC, vomiting, behaviour since, any lucid interval
expected.actionZh: 向目击者采集现病史：击打次数、凶器、昏迷时长、呕吐、此后表现、有无中间清醒期

expected.actionEn: Pain score if obtainable; document that reliability is limited by confusion
expected.actionZh: 尽可能采集疼痛评分；注明因意识错乱可靠性受限

expected.actionEn: PMHx from family/police - specifically anticoagulant use
expected.actionZh: 从家属/警察获取既往史——特别是抗凝药使用情况

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI including alcohol
expected.actionZh: 最后进食（含饮酒）

phases.infoEn: Set 1: GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6 - eyes to voice, confused, obeys commands); BP 168/92; pulse 58 strong bounding; respirations 14 regular; skin pale warm dry; PUPILS - right 5 mm sluggish, left 3 mm brisk (UNEQUAL - a critical finding); SpO2 93% RA rising to 98% on oxygen; BGL 5.6 (indicated with altered LOC); temperature 36.2 (indicated - cold wet ground). Widening pulse pressure with bradycardia and unequal pupils suggests rising intracranial pressure. RTC interval 5-6 minutes and pupils MUST be repeated every set.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6——呼唤睁眼、言语错乱、能执行指令）；血压 168/92；脉搏 58 有力洪大；呼吸 14 规则；皮肤苍白温干；瞳孔——右侧 5 mm 反应迟钝、左侧 3 mm 反应灵敏（不等大，为关键发现）；SpO2 室内空气 93%，吸氧后升至 98%；血糖 5.6（意识改变时有指征）；体温 36.2（有指征——冰冷潮湿地面）。脉压增宽合并心动过缓与瞳孔不等大提示颅内压升高。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟，且每组必须复查瞳孔。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components and the correct total (E3 V4 M6 = 13, moderate TBI)
expected.actionZh: GCS 三项分别评分并得出正确总分（E3 V4 M6 = 13，中度颅脑损伤）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - recognize hypertension with a widening pulse pressure
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——识别高血压伴脉压增宽

expected.actionEn: Pulse - recognize bradycardia with a bounding character
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——识别心动过缓伴洪大脉

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character; watch for irregular patterns
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质；警惕呼吸节律异常

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils - identify and act on the unequal, sluggish right pupil; repeat with every set
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——发现并处置右侧不等大、反应迟钝的瞳孔；每组必查

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration; keep at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准；维持≥94%

expected.actionEn: BGL - indicated with any altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 血糖——任何意识改变均有指征

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated after exposure on cold wet ground
expected.actionZh: 体温——冰冷潮湿地面暴露后有指征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, limited by the patient's confusion. EXAMINER NOTE: no deduction for FE systems the patient cannot answer - document the limitation and obtain what you can from witnesses. Available: general - fit, no recent illness; CNS - LOC 2 minutes, confused, headache, no seizure witnessed; respiratory nil; cardiovascular nil; GI/GU - vomited twice; integumentary - scalp laceration; musculoskeletal nil; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - blurred vision reported once, no fluid from ears.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中完成，受患者意识错乱限制。考官提示：患者无法回答的系统不扣分——记录该限制并尽量从目击者处获取。可得信息：整体——身体健康、近期无疾病；中枢神经——昏迷 2 分钟、意识错乱、头痛、未见抽搐；呼吸无；心血管无；消化/泌尿——呕吐两次；皮肤——头皮裂伤；肌肉骨骼无；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——曾诉视物模糊一次、耳部无液体流出。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (from witnesses/family)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康（向目击者/家属获取）

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (pertinent: LOC duration, headache, seizure, vision)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（重点：昏迷时长、头痛、抽搐、视觉）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (vomiting is a TBI red flag)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（呕吐是颅脑损伤警示征）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (vision, ear/nose discharge)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（视觉、耳鼻分泌物）

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe (mostly en route): head/neck - 6 cm right temporal laceration with boggy swelling, bleeding controlled by direct pressure, no depression palpable, no CSF from ears or nose, no Battle sign or raccoon eyes yet, no midline cervical tenderness elicited but he is unreliable; chest - clear and equal 6 sites; abdomen - soft; back - checked during the roll onto the device, no injury; lower extremities - moves both to command, no injury; upper extremities - moves both, grip equal, no injury.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚（主要在途中完成）：头颈——右颞部 6 cm 裂伤伴松软肿胀，直接加压后出血已控制，未触及凹陷，耳鼻无脑脊液，暂无 Battle 征或熊猫眼，颈椎中线未引出压痛但患者可靠性差；胸部——6 点听诊清晰对称；腹部——软；背部——滚动上板时已查、无损伤；下肢——能按指令活动双侧、无损伤；上肢——双侧能活动、握力对称、无损伤。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam: DOTS, skull depression, CSF from ears/nose, Battle sign, raccoon eyes
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体：DOTS、颅骨凹陷、耳鼻脑脊液、Battle 征、熊猫眼

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam during the roll
expected.actionZh: 滚动时完成背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with motor and sensory check
expected.actionZh: 下肢并查运动与感觉

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with grip strength comparison
expected.actionZh: 上肢并对比握力

phases.infoEn: TBI guideline, all levels: maintain SpO2 at or above 94% (assist ventilations if respirations fail, keeping SpO2 at or above 94% - do NOT hyperventilate routinely); elevate the head of the bed 30 degrees; LOOSEN the hard collar once the patient is secured; suction as needed; dress the scalp laceration with direct pressure. Spinal packaging with the head elevated. PCP ADDITIONS: maintain blood sugar 4.0-8.0 mmol/L; maintain systolic BP above 120 mmHg; IV TKVO if systolic is above 120. TXA IS CONTRAINDICATED in isolated TBI - a candidate who gives it here commits a major protocol error.
phases.infoZh: 颅脑损伤指南（各级别）：维持 SpO2≥94%（呼吸衰竭时辅助通气并保持 SpO2≥94%，不做常规过度通气）；床头抬高 30 度；患者固定后放松硬质颈托；按需吸引；头皮裂伤直接加压包扎。脊柱打包并抬高头部。PCP 追加：维持血糖 4.0-8.0 mmol/L；维持收缩压高于 120 mmHg；收缩压高于 120 时静脉通路 TKVO。孤立性颅脑损伤禁用 TXA——此处给药属重大协议错误。

expected.actionEn: Maintain oxygenation at or above 94% and be prepared to assist ventilations without routine hyperventilation
expected.actionZh: 维持氧合≥94%，随时准备辅助通气但不做常规过度通气

expected.actionEn: Elevate the head of the bed 30 degrees and loosen the hard collar after securing
expected.actionZh: 床头抬高 30 度，固定后放松硬质颈托

expected.actionEn: Spinal packaging performed correctly (collar, device, body before head, no head tape)
expected.actionZh: 正确完成脊柱打包（颈托、装置、先躯干后头部、不用胶带缠头）

expected.actionEn: Airway management: suction correctly (10-15 seconds adult), adjunct sized and inserted appropriately, patient positioned to protect against aspiration
expected.actionZh: 气道管理：正确吸引（成人 10-15 秒）、辅助装置尺寸与置入正确、体位防误吸

expected.actionEn: Do NOT administer TXA - contraindicated in isolated TBI
expected.actionZh: 不得给 TXA——孤立性颅脑损伤为禁忌

expected.actionEn: PCP: IV TKVO with systolic above 120, and keep BGL between 4.0 and 8.0
expected.actionZh: PCP：收缩压高于 120 时静脉 TKVO，并维持血糖 4.0-8.0

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, GCS and PUPILS after every move and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, 6 minutes later): GCS 11 (E2 V4 M5 - eyes to pain now, still confused, localizes); BP 178/88; pulse 52 bounding; respirations 12 and becoming irregular; skin pale warm dry; pupils right 6 mm non-reactive, left 3 mm reactive; SpO2 97% on oxygen; BGL 5.6. He is DETERIORATING - the candidate must recognize the falling GCS, support ventilations to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, keep suction ready, and expedite transport with an urgent notification.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及至少每 5 分钟复评 ABC、GCS 和瞳孔。第 2 组（途中，6 分钟后）：GCS 11（E2 V4 M5——现在需疼痛刺激才睁眼、仍言语错乱、能定位疼痛）；血压 178/88；脉搏 52 洪大；呼吸 12 且渐不规则；皮肤苍白温干；瞳孔右 6 mm 无反应、左 3 mm 有反应；SpO2 吸氧下 97%；血糖 5.6。病情正在恶化——考生必须识别 GCS 下降，辅助通气维持 SpO2≥94%，备好吸引，并加快转运、紧急预报。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each major move and after any change in LOC
expected.actionZh: 每次大移动后及意识状态变化后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes including a repeat GCS and pupils
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，含复评 GCS 与瞳孔

expected.actionEn: Recognize the deteriorating GCS and pupil change and escalate care (assist ventilations, suction ready, urgent notification)
expected.actionZh: 识别 GCS 下降与瞳孔变化并升级处置（辅助通气、备好吸引、紧急预报）

expected.actionEn: Assist ventilations at an appropriate rate with the BVM connected to oxygen, confirming chest rise
expected.actionZh: 以合适频率用连接氧气的球囊面罩辅助通气，并确认胸廓起伏

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - urgent en-route notification to the trauma centre stating the GCS trend and pupil findings. Structured hand-off; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——紧急向创伤中心途中预报，说明 GCS 变化趋势和瞳孔发现。结构化交接；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Urgent trauma-centre notification including GCS trend and unequal pupils
expected.actionZh: 紧急创伤中心预报（含 GCS 趋势与瞳孔不等大）

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with both GCS scores broken down by component
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，两次 GCS 均按分项报告

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

R 6 mm non-reactive, L 3 mm reactive

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving TXA for an isolated TBI - explicitly contraindicated, major protocol error 100%
No c-spine control with blunt head trauma and altered LOC - 100%
Not suctioning a vomiting patient with a decreased LOC, or leaving him unprotected against aspiration - 100% (Airway)
Not repeating pupils and GCS with every set and missing the deterioration - pupil/GCS deductions plus a major protocol failure
Routine hyperventilation, or allowing SpO2 to fall below 94% in a TBI patient - protocol error
criticalPitfallsZh: 对孤立性颅脑损伤给 TXA——明文禁忌，重大协议错误扣 100%
钝性头部外伤伴意识改变却不做颈椎固定——扣 100%
对意识下降的呕吐患者不吸引、不做误吸防护——扣 100%（Airway）
不做每组瞳孔与 GCS 复评、漏掉病情恶化——瞳孔/GCS 扣分外加重大协议失分
常规过度通气，或让颅脑损伤患者 SpO2 低于 94%——协议错误
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: spinal packaging, suction, airway adjuncts, oxygenation at or above 94%, assisted ventilations, head of bed at 30 degrees, collar loosened, serial GCS and pupils, and rapid transport. No IV, no blood-sugar correction beyond recognizing the BGL. No Functional Enquiry. TXA is not in EMR scope and remains contraindicated regardless.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：脊柱打包、吸引、气道辅助装置、维持氧合≥94%、辅助通气、床头抬高 30 度、放松颈托、连续复查 GCS 与瞳孔、快速转运。无静脉通路，除识别血糖外不做纠正。无功能问诊。TXA 不在 EMR 范围内，且本例本身即为禁忌。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds IV TKVO (only if systolic is above 120 mmHg), maintenance of blood sugar between 4.0 and 8.0 mmol/L, maintenance of systolic above 120 mmHg, and the Functional Enquiry as far as the patient's confusion allows. TXA remains contraindicated.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加静脉 TKVO（仅在收缩压高于 120 mmHg 时）、维持血糖 4.0-8.0 mmol/L、维持收缩压高于 120 mmHg，以及在患者意识允许范围内完成功能问诊。TXA 仍为禁忌。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 38-year-old male assaulted at approximately 2305, struck once to the right temple with a baseball bat, with about 2 minutes of loss of consciousness and two episodes of vomiting since. Chief complaint is head injury with altered mental status. On our arrival GCS was 13, eyes to voice, confused, obeying commands, with BP 168/92, pulse 58 and bounding, resps 14, SpO2 93% on room air, BGL 5.6, temperature 36.2, and an unequal right pupil at 5 millimetres and sluggish. Six minutes later he is GCS 11, eyes to pain now, BP 178/88, pulse 52, resps 12 and irregular, right pupil 6 millimetres and non-reactive - he is deteriorating with signs of rising intracranial pressure. No significant medical history, no anticoagulants, no known allergies, two beers with dinner. Treatments: airway suctioned, oxygen to keep saturations above 94 percent with ventilations now assisted, manual c-spine and full spinal packaging with the collar loosened and head of bed at 30 degrees, scalp laceration controlled with direct pressure, IV TKVO. No TXA - contraindicated in isolated head injury.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 38 岁男性，约 23:05 遭袭击，右颞部被棒球棒击中一次，昏迷约 2 分钟，此后呕吐两次。主诉为头部损伤伴精神状态改变。我们到场时 GCS 13，呼唤睁眼、言语错乱、能执行指令，血压 168/92、脉搏 58 洪大、呼吸 14、SpO2 室内空气 93%、血糖 5.6、体温 36.2，右侧瞳孔 5 mm 且反应迟钝，双侧不等大。6 分钟后 GCS 降至 11，改为疼痛刺激才睁眼，血压 178/88、脉搏 52、呼吸 12 且不规则，右瞳 6 mm 无反应——病情恶化，提示颅内压升高。无重要既往史、未服抗凝药、无已知过敏，晚餐时饮啤酒两瓶。处置：气道吸引，给氧维持血氧高于 94% 并已开始辅助通气，徒手固定颈椎后全脊柱打包、颈托放松、床头抬高 30 度，头皮裂伤直接加压止血，静脉 TKVO。未给 TXA——孤立性颅脑损伤禁用。

scenarios.titleZh: 花生暴露后过敏性休克
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1915 hrs. Code 3 to a Thai restaurant in New Westminster. 24-year-old female with a known peanut allergy has an allergic reaction. Staff say she is having trouble breathing. Hospital is 9 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 19:15，Code 3 前往新西敏一家泰国餐厅。24 岁女性，已知花生过敏，出现过敏反应。店员称她呼吸困难。医院车程 9 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: caller says her face is swelling and she used to carry an EpiPen but does not have it tonight.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：报警人称她面部肿胀，她平时带 EpiPen 但今晚没带。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan epinephrine, oxygen, salbutamol, BVM, early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备肾上腺素、氧气、沙丁胺醇、球囊面罩，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch this is likely an unstable anaphylaxis call
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即预判这很可能是不稳定的过敏性休克

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Busy restaurant, staff have cleared a path to a corner booth. The patient is slumped sideways in the booth, flushed, with obvious facial and lip swelling, audible wheeze and stridor. Her friend is beside her holding a plate of pad thai. Room temperature, no hazards. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：餐厅客满，店员已清出通往角落卡座的通道。患者侧歪在卡座上，面色潮红，面部及口唇明显肿胀，可闻及喘鸣和吸气性喉鸣。朋友在旁边端着一盘泰式炒河粉。室温正常，无危险源。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment, nature of illness (allergic reaction / possible ongoing allergen), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无）、环境、发病性质（过敏反应/可能仍在接触过敏原）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: flushed, facial/lip swelling, audible stridor and wheeze, slumped posture
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：潮红、面唇肿胀、可闻及喉鸣与喘鸣、身体瘫软

expected.actionEn: Remove/stop the allergen exposure (clear the food away)
expected.actionZh: 移除/终止过敏原暴露（把食物拿开）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake but drowsy, answers in one or two words, clutching her throat, says 'can't... breathe'. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - swollen, stridor present but she is still moving air; respirations 30, laboured with accessory muscle use and audible wheeze; radial pulse 130 weak. Skin: flushed with widespread urticaria (hives) over chest and arms, warm and moist. RBS: no trauma, no injection sites, no stinger. SpO2 88% RA. C-spine NOT indicated. UNSTABLE: anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒但嗜睡，只能一两个词回答，手抓喉咙，说「喘…不上气」。考官（评估时给出）：气道——肿胀、有喉鸣但仍有气流通过；呼吸 30 次/分、费力、动用辅助呼吸肌、可闻及喘鸣；桡动脉 130 次/分、细弱。皮肤：潮红，胸部和双臂广泛荨麻疹，温热潮湿。RBS：无外伤、无注射痕迹、无蜂刺。SpO2 室内空气 88%。无颈椎固定指征。不稳定：过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Verbal, drowsy - a decreased LOC finding
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：对言语有反应、嗜睡——属意识下降

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical, no trauma)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway - identify swelling and stridor as an airway threat
expected.actionZh: 评估气道——识别肿胀与喉鸣为气道威胁

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing - rate, effort, accessory muscle use, wheeze
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸——频率、做功、辅助肌使用、喘鸣

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - weak rapid radial pulse
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——桡动脉细速

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey looking for hives, stinger/injection site and other causes
expected.actionZh: 做改良快速查体，寻找荨麻疹、蜂刺/注射部位及其他原因

expected.actionEn: Note skin: flushed, urticaria, warm moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：潮红、荨麻疹、温热潮湿

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB to target SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 高流量吸氧 15 L 非再吸入面罩，目标 SpO2≥94%

expected.actionEn: Position SUPINE to support blood pressure and do NOT walk the patient (per Anaphylaxis guideline)
expected.actionZh: 按过敏性休克指南置仰卧位以维持血压，且绝不让患者行走

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC = UNSTABLE, RTC. Give epinephrine on scene then transport - do not delay for a full secondary survey. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Delegate crew to prep egress while you run the protocol.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降=不稳定，RTC。现场给肾上腺素后转运——不要为完成完整二次评估而拖延。15 分钟内可装载。执行协议同时指派搭档准备撤离路线。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Epinephrine given on scene, then ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 现场给予肾上腺素后 15 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate crew members to prep egress (explicitly required by the Anaphylaxis guideline)
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档准备撤离通道（过敏性休克指南明确要求）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR / FRIEND ANSWERS (patient can only manage a few words; use the friend): ate pad thai, first mouthful about 8 minutes ago, told the server 'no peanuts'; itching and throat tightness within 2 minutes, then swelling. Known peanut anaphylaxis, two previous ER visits, one previous EpiPen use. Onset sudden, severity worst ever, no relief. PMHx: peanut anaphylaxis, mild asthma. Meds: salbutamol MDI prn, EpiPen (not with her, expired last month). Allergies: peanuts (anaphylaxis), shellfish (hives). LOI: the pad thai just now, water.
phases.infoZh: 患者/朋友回答（患者只能说几个词，主要问朋友）：吃了泰式炒河粉，第一口约在 8 分钟前，点餐时特意说过「不要花生」；2 分钟内出现瘙痒和喉咙发紧，随后肿胀。已知花生过敏性休克，曾两次进急诊，用过一次 EpiPen。起病突然，是历来最重的一次，无缓解。既往史：花生过敏性休克、轻度哮喘。用药：沙丁胺醇定量吸入剂按需、EpiPen（未随身，上月已过期）。过敏：花生（过敏性休克）、贝类（荨麻疹）。最后进食：刚才的炒河粉和水。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: difficulty breathing and throat swelling after eating
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：进食后呼吸困难与咽喉肿胀

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST/LOTARP: onset, allergen, time from exposure, progression, previous reactions, severity
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 采集现病史：起病、过敏原、暴露到发病时间、进展、既往反应、严重程度

expected.actionEn: PMHx (peanut anaphylaxis, asthma)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（花生过敏性休克、哮喘）

expected.actionEn: Medications incl EpiPen availability and expiry
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含 EpiPen 是否随身及有效期）

expected.actionEn: Allergies with consequence detail
expected.actionZh: 过敏史及其后果细节

expected.actionEn: LOI - identifies the exposure
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——确定暴露源

expected.actionEn: Use the friend as a history source when the patient cannot speak
expected.actionZh: 患者说不了话时改由朋友提供病史

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE epinephrine (required before initiating a protocol): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6, confused); BP 84/50; pulse 130 weak regular; respirations 30 laboured with wheeze; skin flushed, urticarial, warm moist; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 88% RA. BGL 6.1 if checked (altered LOC - reasonable). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——给肾上腺素前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6，言语错乱）；血压 84/50；脉搏 130 细弱规则；呼吸 30 费力伴喘鸣；皮肤潮红、有荨麻疹、温热潮湿；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 88%。若测血糖为 6.1（意识改变，测血糖合理）。体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (14: E4 V4 M6)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（14：E4 V4 M6）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - recognize BP under 90 systolic as an anaphylaxis instability criterion
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——识别收缩压低于 90 为过敏性休克不稳定标准

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character incl wheeze
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质（含喘鸣）

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, condition, extent of urticaria
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、状态、荨麻疹范围

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

expected.actionEn: BGL - reasonable with altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 血糖——意识改变时合理

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route AFTER epinephrine, brief. ACTOR (improving, now able to talk): general - felt fine until dinner; CNS - felt faint, no headache; respiratory - throat tightness and wheeze, improving; cardiovascular - heart racing (expected after epinephrine); GI/GU - crampy abdominal pain and nausea; integumentary - itching and hives all over; musculoskeletal nil; endocrine nil; EENT - lip and tongue swelling, eyes itchy and puffy.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，给肾上腺素后在途中简要完成。患者演员（好转，已能说话）：整体——晚餐前一切正常；中枢神经——曾觉眩晕、无头痛；呼吸——咽紧和喘鸣，正在好转；心血管——心跳快（用肾上腺素后预期表现）；消化/泌尿——腹部绞痛伴恶心；皮肤——全身瘙痒和风团；肌肉骨骼无；内分泌无；眼耳鼻喉——口唇及舌肿胀、眼痒浮肿。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (pertinent)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（与主诉相关）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (abdominal cramps are an anaphylaxis sign)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（腹部绞痛属过敏性休克表现）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (urticaria)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤（荨麻疹）

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (angioedema)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（血管性水肿）

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - lip and tongue swelling, stridor decreasing after epinephrine, no JVD; chest - expiratory wheeze in all fields on 6-site auscultation, improving after salbutamol; abdomen - soft, mild generalized tenderness; back - urticaria across the back; lower extremities - urticaria, CSM intact; upper extremities - urticaria, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——口唇及舌肿胀，用肾上腺素后喉鸣减轻，无颈静脉怒张；胸部——6 点听诊各野呼气相喘鸣，沙丁胺醇后好转；腹部——软，轻度弥漫压痛；背部——背部可见荨麻疹；下肢——荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl airway swelling reassessment
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含气道肿胀复评）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation, bilateral comparison
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities
expected.actionZh: 下肢

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities
expected.actionZh: 上肢

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS: remove allergen, supine, high-flow O2, baseline vitals, then EPINEPHRINE 0.5 mg IM (adult) - there are no absolute contraindications in life-threatening anaphylaxis; may repeat every 5 minutes up to 3 times. Then transport and continue treatment en route. PCP ADDITIONS: vascular access and 20 mL/kg fluid bolus (max 2 L, reassess q500 mL) if still hypotensive; salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI for bronchospasm AFTER epinephrine has been given; diphenhydramine 25-50 mg to limit the histamine response. Note: epinephrine first - salbutamol or antihistamine INSTEAD of epinephrine is a major protocol error.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用：移除过敏原、仰卧、高流量吸氧、完成基线生命体征，然后肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg（成人）——危及生命的过敏性休克无绝对禁忌；可每 5 分钟重复，最多 3 次。随后转运并在途中继续治疗。PCP 追加：仍低血压时建立静脉通路并 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评）；肾上腺素已给后再用沙丁胺醇雾化或定量吸入剂处理支气管痉挛；苯海拉明 25-50 mg 抑制组胺反应。注意：必须先给肾上腺素——用沙丁胺醇或抗组胺药替代肾上腺素属重大协议错误。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Anaphylaxis protocol with correct indications (signs + exposure + instability) and baseline vitals done
expected.actionZh: 在指征正确（症状+暴露+不稳定）且基线生命体征已完成的前提下启动过敏性休克协议

expected.actionEn: Administer epinephrine 0.5 mg IM with the 6 rights, correct site (anterolateral thigh) and IM needle
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg，部位正确（大腿前外侧）并使用肌注针

expected.actionEn: Verbalize repeat dosing: may repeat 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes up to 3 doses if no improvement
expected.actionZh: 口述重复给药：无改善时可每 5 分钟重复 0.5 mg 肌注，最多 3 次

expected.actionEn: PCP: salbutamol for bronchospasm only AFTER epinephrine; diphenhydramine 25-50 mg; IV with fluid bolus if still hypotensive
expected.actionZh: PCP：支气管痉挛在肾上腺素之后再用沙丁胺醇；苯海拉明 25-50 mg；仍低血压时静脉补液

expected.actionEn: Do not allow the patient to stand or walk to the stretcher
expected.actionZh: 不允许患者站立或自行走到担架床

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions 5 minutes after epinephrine and after each move. Set 2 (5 minutes post-epinephrine, en route): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 106/68; pulse 118 stronger; respirations 22, wheeze reduced, stridor resolved; skin still flushed with fading hives, warm dry; pupils equal; SpO2 96% on 15 L. Improving - document the response; if it had NOT improved, a second 0.5 mg IM dose at 5 minutes is required.
phases.infoZh: 肾上腺素后 5 分钟及每次移动后复评 ABC 与各项处置。第 2 组（给药后 5 分钟，途中）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 106/68；脉搏 118 较前有力；呼吸 22，喘鸣减轻、喉鸣消失；皮肤仍潮红、风团渐退、温干；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 下 96%。病情好转——记录治疗反应；若未好转，须在 5 分钟时追加第二剂 0.5 mg 肌注。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after epinephrine and after each move
expected.actionZh: 给药后及每次移动后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes and interpret the response to epinephrine
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读对肾上腺素的反应

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the plan for a repeat dose if deterioration or no improvement occurs
expected.actionZh: 口述若病情恶化或无改善的重复给药计划

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (allergic airway). Structured hand-off with drug times and response; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（过敏性气道问题）。结构化交接，含给药时间与反应；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with epinephrine time, dose, route and response
expected.actionZh: 完整交接（肾上腺素时间、剂量、途径与反应）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving salbutamol or diphenhydramine instead of / before epinephrine - major protocol error up to 100%
Initiating the protocol without a baseline set of vital signs - 100%
Walking the patient to the stretcher or sitting her up when hypotensive - 100% (guideline says supine, do not walk)
Not reassessing at 5 minutes and missing the indication for a repeat epinephrine dose - major delay in subsequent doses, 100%
Treating as non-RTC and completing a full on-scene secondary survey - transport category error, 25%
criticalPitfallsZh: 用沙丁胺醇或苯海拉明替代肾上腺素、或抢在其之前给——重大协议错误，最高扣 100%
未做基线生命体征就启动协议——扣 100%
让低血压患者自行走向担架或坐起——扣 100%（指南要求仰卧、禁止行走）
5 分钟不复评、错过重复给肾上腺素的指征——后续剂量重大延误，扣 100%
当作非 RTC、在现场做完整二次评估——转运分类错误，扣 25%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives epinephrine 0.5 mg IM (repeat q5 min up to 3 doses), oxygen, supine positioning and rapid transport. EMR does NOT give diphenhydramine or IV fluids; salbutamol is within EMR scope for bronchospasm but only after epinephrine. No Functional Enquiry.

scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 24-year-old female with known peanut anaphylaxis, chief complaint of throat swelling and difficulty breathing about 8 minutes after eating pad thai. On our arrival she had stridor, wheeze, facial and lip angioedema, widespread urticaria, GCS 14, BP 84/50, pulse 130 weak, resps 30 laboured, SpO2 88% on room air, BGL 6.1. She received epinephrine 0.5 milligrams IM to the left anterolateral thigh at 1922, high-flow oxygen, supine positioning, salbutamol by nebulizer and diphenhydramine 50 milligrams, with an IV and saline running. Five minutes post-epinephrine she is GCS 15, BP 106/68, pulse 118, resps 22, SpO2 96% on 15 litres, stridor resolved. History of peanut anaphylaxis and mild asthma, uses a salbutamol inhaler, her EpiPen was expired and not with her, allergic to peanuts and shellfish.

scenarios.titleEn: Cardiac Chest Pain - ASA and Nitroglycerin
scenarios.titleZh: 心源性胸痛——阿司匹林与硝酸甘油
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0640 hrs. Code 3 to a townhouse complex in Coquitlam. 62-year-old male with central chest pain that woke him from sleep. His wife made the call. Hospital with a cath lab is 14 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 06:40，Code 3 前往高贵林一处联排住宅。62 岁男性因胸骨后疼痛从睡梦中痛醒。其妻报警。设有心导管室的医院车程 14 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: he is conscious, sweating, and has not taken anything for the pain. No prescribed nitroglycerin in the house.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：患者清醒、出汗，尚未服用任何止痛药物。家中没有处方硝酸甘油。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan ASA, nitroglycerin, oxygen, cot to the patient, minimal-exertion approach
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备阿司匹林、硝酸甘油、氧气，把担架床推到患者身边，采取减少活动的策略

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a time-critical cardiac call and plan early transport with hospital notification
expected.actionZh: 预判为时间敏感的心脏事件，计划尽早转运并通知医院

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Wife meets you at the door and leads you upstairs to the bedroom. Warm room, well lit, stairs are the only egress challenge - 14 steps, narrow turn. The patient sits on the edge of the bed, grey and diaphoretic, fist clenched over his sternum. One patient. No hazards, no pets, no smoking materials.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：妻子在门口迎接并带你上楼进卧室。房间温暖、照明良好，唯一的搬运难点是楼梯——14 级台阶，转角狭窄。患者坐在床沿，面色灰白、大汗，握拳按在胸骨上。单一患者。无危险源、无宠物、无吸烟物品。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (stair egress), environment, nature of illness (chest pain), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（楼梯搬运）、环境、发病性质（胸痛）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Plan the stair egress early and bring equipment to the patient rather than walking him

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and oriented, speaking in short sentences because of the pain, says it feels like a weight on his chest. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 22, slightly laboured, no wheeze; radial pulse 96, regular, normal strength. Skin: pale, cool, diaphoretic. Modified rapid body survey: no trauma, no edema, no obvious abnormality; abdomen soft. SpO2 96% RA. C-spine not indicated. UNSTABLE by BC criteria: suspected cardiac chest pain.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常，因疼痛只能短句说话，形容像有重物压在胸口。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 22 次/分、略费力、无喘鸣；桡动脉 96 次/分、规则、强度正常。皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗。改良快速查体：无外伤、无水肿、无明显异常；腹部软。SpO2 室内空气 96%。无颈椎固定指征。按 BC 标准属不稳定：疑似心源性胸痛。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Suspected cardiac chest pain = UNSTABLE, RTC. The guideline says transport immediately if able; if not, delegate crew to prep egress. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Give nitroglycerin, then transport after the first dose if not already moving.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。疑似心源性胸痛=不稳定，RTC。指南要求：能立即转运就立即转运；不能则指派搭档准备撤离路线。15 分钟内可装载。给硝酸甘油，若尚未出发则在第一剂后转运。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS: woke at 0615 with central chest pressure. O - at rest, woke him. P - nothing makes it better, deep breathing does not change it. Q - heavy pressure, like a band. R - radiates to the left jaw and down the left arm. R (relief) - none. R (recurrence) - had two similar milder episodes with exertion this week that settled with rest. S - 8/10. T - constant for 25 minutes. Associated: nausea, sweating, short of breath. PMHx: hypertension, high cholesterol, ex-smoker (quit 3 years, 30 pack-years), father died of MI at 58. Meds: amlodipine 5 mg, rosuvastatin 10 mg. NO erectile dysfunction medication - specifically denies Viagra, Levitra or Cialis. Allergies: none known. LOI: dinner at 1900 last night, nothing since.

phases.infoEn: Cardiac Chest Pain protocol, all levels: position of comfort, limit movement, oxygen only to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, ASA 160 mg PO chewed after the RBS, initiate transport, history and baseline vitals, then NITROGLYCERIN 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes provided systolic BP stays above 110, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period, until pain free. Repeat vital signs before EVERY dose. Do not shake the spray; verbalize priming. If pain persists beyond 3 doses or systolic falls below 110, give Entonox 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin dose. PCP ADDITIONS: vascular access with running fluid; consider dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a max 50 mg for nausea.
phases.infoZh: 心源性胸痛协议（各级别通用）：舒适体位、限制活动、按维持 SpO2≥94% 给氧、快速查体后阿司匹林 160 mg 嚼服、启动转运、采集病史与基线生命体征，然后硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下含服，每 3-5 分钟一次，前提是收缩压持续高于 110，30 分钟内最多 3 剂，直至无痛。每次给药前都要复测生命体征。喷雾剂给药前不要摇晃，需口述预喷排气。若 3 剂后疼痛持续或收缩压降至 110 以下，在最后一剂硝酸甘油后 5 分钟给 Entonox。PCP 追加：建立静脉通路并持续输液；恶心可考虑苯海拉明类止吐药茶苯海明 1 mg/kg（上限 50 mg）。

expected.actionZh: 按正确指征与顺序启动心源性胸痛协议（阿司匹林在快速查体后，硝酸甘油在基线生命体征后）

expected.actionEn: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL with contraindications ruled out (SBP under 110, HR under 50 or over 150, nitrate allergy, PDE5 inhibitor use) and vitals repeated before each dose
expected.actionZh: 硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下并排除禁忌（收缩压低于 110、心率低于 50 或高于 150、硝酸盐过敏、PDE5 抑制剂用药），每剂前复测生命体征

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the maximum of 3 nitroglycerin doses in 30 minutes and the Entonox rule (5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin dose)
expected.actionZh: 口述 30 分钟内硝酸甘油最多 3 剂，以及 Entonox 规则（末次硝酸甘油后 5 分钟）

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access with running fluid; consider dimenhydrinate for nausea
expected.actionZh: PCP：建立静脉通路并持续输液；恶心时考虑茶苯海明

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and pain after every dose and every move. Set 2 (after 2 doses of nitroglycerin, en route): GCS 15; BP 122/78; pulse 88 regular; respirations 18; skin pink, warm, drying; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 97% RA; pain down from 8/10 to 3/10. Note the systolic remains above 110, so a third dose is permitted if pain persists. If the candidate does not recheck BP before dosing, EXAMINER drops the BP to 96/60 to test whether they withhold the next dose.
phases.infoZh: 每次给药和每次移动后复评 ABC 与疼痛。第 2 组（给两剂硝酸甘油后，途中）：GCS 15；血压 122/78；脉搏 88 规则；呼吸 18；皮肤转红润、温暖、汗渐干；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 97%；疼痛由 8/10 降至 3/10。注意收缩压仍高于 110，故疼痛持续时可给第三剂。若考生给药前不复测血压，考官将把血压改为 96/60，检验其是否会停止下一剂。

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving nitroglycerin without a baseline set of vital signs, or without rechecking BP before each dose - 100% (Protocols)
Not screening for Viagra/Levitra in the last 24 h or Cialis in the last 48 h before nitroglycerin - failure to rule out contraindications, up to 100%
Letting the patient walk down the stairs to the ambulance - exertion in cardiac chest pain, overall patient care deduction up to 100%
Applying high-flow oxygen when SpO2 is 96% - oxygen is titrated to 94% or above in a patient who is not SOB or shocked
Omitting ASA when not contraindicated, or giving it before the rapid body survey - protocol sequencing error
criticalPitfallsZh: 未做基线生命体征就给硝酸甘油，或每剂前不复测血压——扣 100%（Protocols）
给硝酸甘油前不筛查 24 小时内万艾可/艾力达或 48 小时内希爱力——未排除禁忌，最高扣 100%
让患者自己走下楼上救护车——心源性胸痛下的用力，患者照护类最高扣 100%
SpO2 96% 时仍上高流量吸氧——不气促、不休克的患者应滴定至 94% 以上即可
无禁忌却不给阿司匹林，或在快速查体之前就给——协议顺序错误

scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 62-year-old male, chief complaint of central chest pressure that woke him at 0615, so about 45 minutes of pain now. It is a heavy band-like pressure radiating to the left jaw and left arm, 8 out of 10 at onset, associated with nausea and diaphoresis, not reproducible on palpation, and he had two exertional episodes earlier this week. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 148/92, pulse 96 regular, resps 22, skin pale cool diaphoretic, SpO2 96% on room air; latest BP 122/78, pulse 88, SpO2 97%, pain now 3 out of 10. History of hypertension and dyslipidemia, ex-smoker, father died of an MI at 58, takes amlodipine and rosuvastatin, no PDE5 inhibitors, no known allergies, last ate at 1900 yesterday. Treatments: kept at rest and carried out, ASA 160 milligrams chewed at 0652, nitroglycerin 0.4 milligrams sublingual at 0658 and 0703 with blood pressure rechecked before each dose, IV established en route.

scenarios.dispatchEn: 0730 hrs. Code 3 to an assisted-living apartment in Victoria. 74-year-old female, known insulin-dependent diabetic, found by a care aide unresponsive in her armchair. Hospital is 11 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 07:30，Code 3 前往维多利亚一处协助生活公寓。74 岁女性，已知胰岛素依赖型糖尿病，被护理员发现在扶手椅上无反应。医院车程 11 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the care aide says she took her morning insulin but refused breakfast. She is breathing but will not wake up.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：护理员称她打了早上的胰岛素但拒绝吃早餐。目前有呼吸但叫不醒。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan glucometer, glucose gel, glucagon (EMR) or D10W (PCP), suction, oxygen, BVM
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备血糖仪、葡萄糖凝胶、胰高血糖素（EMR）或 D10W（PCP）、吸引器、氧气、球囊面罩

expected.actionEn: Anticipate an unresponsive medical patient - airway first, and BGL is mandatory
expected.actionZh: 预判为无反应的内科患者——优先气道，且必须测血糖

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The care aide lets you into a small warm suite. The patient is slumped in an armchair, head fallen forward onto her chest, snoring loudly. An insulin pen and a used needle are on the side table beside an untouched breakfast tray. No spilled pills, no alcohol. One patient. Warm room, good lighting.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：护理员带你进入一间温暖的小套间。患者瘫坐在扶手椅上，头前倾抵在胸前，鼾声很响。边几上有一支胰岛素笔和一枚用过的针头，旁边是原封未动的早餐托盘。地上无散落药片、无酒瓶。单一患者。房间温暖，照明良好。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (used sharps on the table - important), environment, nature of illness (unresponsive diabetic), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（桌上有用过的针头，重点）、环境、发病性质（无反应的糖尿病患者）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; act on the sharps hazard before working around it
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；在旁边操作前先处理针头危险

expected.actionEn: First look: elderly female slumped forward, snoring respirations, pale and sweaty, untouched breakfast
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：老年女性前倾瘫坐、鼾式呼吸、面色苍白多汗、早餐未动

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: does not respond to voice; withdraws from a trapezius pinch, no eye opening, incomprehensible groaning. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - snoring, partially obstructed by the tongue and her chin-on-chest position; opens with a head-tilt chin-lift or jaw thrust and improves markedly when she is laid supine or positioned lateral; respirations 16, adequate depth once the airway is open; radial pulse 104, strong and regular. Skin: pale, cool, very diaphoretic. Modified RBS: no trauma, no medical alert bracelet found initially - one IS present on the left wrist reading 'Insulin Dependent Diabetic'. SpO2 92% RA. C-spine NOT indicated: no trauma, she was seated and did not fall. UNSTABLE: decreased LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：呼唤无反应；斜方肌掐压时有回缩动作，不睁眼，只有含糊呻吟。考官（评估时给出）：气道——鼾声，因舌后坠与下巴抵胸的体位而部分梗阻；仰头抬颏或推举下颌可打开，改为仰卧或侧卧后明显改善；呼吸 16 次/分，气道打开后深度尚可；桡动脉 104 次/分、有力规则。皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗淋漓。改良快速查体：无外伤，起初未见医疗警示手环——左手腕确有一只，写着「胰岛素依赖型糖尿病」。SpO2 室内空气 92%。无颈椎固定指征：无外伤，患者原本坐着且未跌倒。不稳定：意识下降。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Pain only - a significantly decreased LOC
